deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a spatial description that the tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, which is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The rewrite attributes having a very thin muscle wall to the uterus as a whole, whereas the text indicates that what is being pointed out is a specific thin muscle wall present in the uterus.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This is the outer surface of the uterus. This is normally a very thin muscle wall that is present in the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: the outer surface of the uterus, which normally has a very thin muscle wall.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer uses 'circumspect', which is a slip of the tongue for 'circumscribed'. The rewrite correctly uses 'circumscribed', which is allowed as it places a scientifically correct word in place of a wrong word from the text.
